headline: Spectrum Electrical Industries files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing was made to the stock exchanges as part of routine corporate compliance. Such filings document shareholder approvals for resolutions passed during the annual meeting. The disclosure carries minimal direct financial impact for retail shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on stock price.
